tools.name: poll_alpha_delta_stream
tools.description: Stateful 5-minute delta feed for autonomous trading bots: computes real-time shifts in DEX buy/sell ratio, DeFiLlama APY spreads, and Polymarket odds. WHEN TO USE: Call `poll_alpha_delta_stream` when your task requires deterministic `alpha-stream` analysis for `target`; use `get_agent_wallet_status`

tools.name: get_agent_wallet_status
tools.description: Inspect an agent's account ledger: remaining free trial calls (out of 5), prepaid USD balance, cumulative spend, total API calls, and total LLM tokens saved. WHEN TO USE: Call before a batch of paid tool executions or after completing a Stripe or USDC top-up to confirm your balance. WHEN NOT TO USE:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: poll_alpha_delta_stream · Private data: get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: poll_alpha_delta_stream · Private data: get_agent_wallet_status · Public sink: get_agent_wallet_status · Destructive: get_agent_wallet_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
